name: DASH ECHO
description: Every attempt leaves a trace. Multighost replay, death intelligence, Replay Studio, playback analysis, and cinematic cameras for Geometry Dash.

ghost-count.name: Ghost Count
ghost-count.description: How many historical attempts DASH ECHO should render at once. 0 disables ghost rendering; maximum 6.

death-markers.name: Death Markers
death-markers.description: Show clustered death-zone markers in the level. Death analytics continue recording when markers are hidden.
